name: Voice Interaction & Barge-In Coordinator
purpose: Multilingual wake-word spotting, acoustic energy tracking, barge-in cancellation interlock, and voice token streaming.
registration: WakeWordSpotter::new compiles acoustic wake templates; BargeInCoordinator::new.
execution: WakeWordSpotter::process_audio_frame detects wake trigger; BargeInCoordinator interrupts TTS.
memory_link: Voice tone and speaker metadata associated with episode.
learning_link: Acoustic wake thresholds dynamically calibrate to background ambient noise.
self_evolution_link: Acoustic model parameters updated from confirmed wake events.
curriculum_link: Voice interaction examples included in multimodal dataset training.
safety_gates: Hardware audio interlock prevents self-wake from speaker echo
Barge-in immediately halts outgoing audio generation to conserve compute

lifecycle.1_listen: Continuous audio frame stream ingested from microphone client
lifecycle.2_energy: Compute spectral energy and voice activity detection (VAD)
lifecycle.3_spot: WakeWordSpotter evaluates wake probability against multilingual templates
lifecycle.4_trigger: On positive wake detection, activate TaraBrain conversational session
lifecycle.5_barge_in: If user speaks while Tara is generating response, trigger immediate interrupt
lifecycle.6_stream: Synthesized voice tokens streamed back to client audio renderer
